description: Application to vary condition 1 (approved drawings) of planning permission Ref: DM2026/00254 for the 'Retention and completion of the change of use of the property from Class C3 (a single family dwelling house) to Class C2 (an 8 bedroomed residential care facility for people with learning disabilities and nursing needs) and the demolition of the existing single storey front/flank, rear and rear/flank extensions and detached single storey flank garage, proposed erection of a part one, part two storey side and rear extension, single storey front/flank extension, a dormer extension to the front/flank, internal alterations including the provision of a passenger lift and alteration to the basement layout, alteration to first floor flank and second floor rear fenestrations, provision of a refuse/recycling store to flank/rear of the property and new boundary treatments/access gates to front flanks of the property' to allow for internal alterations to provide additional rooms, alterations fenestrations, installation of rooflights to front and flank roofslopes, provision of a side dormer extension and relocation of the flank refuse store.
